selection_before_archive_payload: Inspect complete central directory; select only epoch-2010/2015/2020 CSV or metadata members if their compressed and decoded lengths fit guards. Primary 2023 eligibility is not inferred from older epochs. No shape-based footprint reselection.
purpose: Reference source availability, fields and fixed-footprint coverage only; no biomass comparison or calibration
decode_invalids: fail closed; preserve strings and provenance; do not execute embedded files

checks: known Content-Range total and exact requested ranges
recheck record file name/size/advertised checksum and HEAD date after inspection
identity_policy.scope: partial source/member consistency, not full-file identity verification

unnamed_member_reason: Inspect epoch fields in the unnamed member before concluding that no 2023 epoch is supplied.
prefetch: Combine adjacent fixed-size blocks into a single HTTP request without increasing cumulative byte or decode guards
